definitions.explanation: A short form of {外務大臣|がいむだいじん}, the cabinet minister in charge of foreign affairs. Common in news headlines and reporting.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}の{外相|がいしょう}が{会談|かいだん}した。
examples.english: The Japanese and American foreign ministers held talks.

examples.japanese: {外相|がいしょう}は{来週|らいしゅう}{訪米|ほうべい}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The Foreign Minister is scheduled to visit the United States next week.

examples.japanese: {各国|かっこく}の{外相|がいしょう}が{集|あつ}まって{国際|こくさい}{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: Foreign ministers from various countries gathered for an international conference.

notes:
An abbreviation of {外務大臣|がいむだいじん} formed with {相|しょう} (minister), the same element seen in {首相|しゅしょう} (prime minister) and {財務相|ざいむしょう} (finance minister). Used mainly in writing and headlines; in speech the full title is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外相|がいしょう}{会談|かいだん}: foreign ministers' talks
- {日本|にほん}の{外相|がいしょう}: Japan's Foreign Minister
- {外相|がいしょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as Foreign Minister
